marco.listaVersiculosAyuda: Tap a verse to go to it.
marco.listaSeccionesAyuda: Tap a section to go to it.
ayudas.sinPalabras: This verse has no key words.
ayudas.noAlineada: It is not known which words of the {texto} these are.
ayudas.nadaEnPalabra: No note or translation word speaks of this word.
persona.cambiarAyuda: Someone else is going to work on this phone
persona.recibirAyuda: Open resources or work that came by card, USB, or Bluetooth
persona.idiomaAyuda: The language of the app's buttons and texts
persona.traducirAyuda: Put the app in your language, with your own words
paquete.elegirAyuda: Look for the file ending in .langpack.zip on the card, the USB drive, or the Bluetooth folder.
paquete.necesita: To mark the words of the notes in the text it also needs: {que}
paquete.listo: Done. You can read {libros} without internet.
idioma.pruebaAyuda: Makes every phrase longer to see what does not fit
interfaz.respaldo: If a phrase is missing, show it in
interfaz.faltaMarca: {marca} is missing: the app puts a value there.
interfaz.muyLarga: It may not fit on a phone.
interfaz.exportarAyuda: To take this translation to another phone
pasos.traduccionAyuda: Write the book in your language
pasos.revisionAyuda: Check the translation against the notes, the words, and the alignment
pasos.comunitariaAyuda: Read the book with the community and note what is not understood
pasos.publicacionAyuda: Prepare the book and upload it to Door43
inicio.sinProyectos: No projects yet. Add one to start.
inicio.compartirAyuda: Take this project to another phone, or upload it to Door43 (coming soon)
agregar.bibliaAyuda: Translate books of the Bible into a language
agregar.obsAyuda: The 50 Open Bible Stories in a language (coming soon)
agregar.recibirAyuda: Open a project or a pack that came by card, USB, or Bluetooth
nuevo.ayuda: All of this can be changed later.
nuevo.ayudasNota: The team translates and checks with the bridge texts and helps of one language. These are the ones on this phone.
nuevo.versificacionAyuda: How verses are numbered. Almost always left as it is.
nuevo.falta: Write the name, the language, and its code.
libroNuevo.enBlancoAyuda: Choose the book and translate it from the beginning
libroNuevo.usfmAyuda: Bring a book already started in another app (coming soon)
libro.faltaPaquete: The texts and helps for {libro} are not on this phone. Receive the {libro} pack to start.
libro.ningunaApp: This step has no mini apps. Whoever coordinates the project chooses them in Settings.
ajustes.miniAppsAyuda: Whoever coordinates the project chooses what each step is done with. Every phone in the project sees the same.
libro.paraElegir: {n} verses with two versions to choose from
libro.recibirAyuda: When each one translated their part on another computer, it all comes together here. What is already written here is not erased: if someone wrote a verse another way, both versions stay for you to choose.
libro.ejemploAviso: In the prototype these are examples, with the TPL's text (Bea) or the TPS's (Carlos) instead of a translation.
libro.recibido: {nombre}'s work ({que}) came together here: {n} new verses.
libro.recibidoElegir: {n} verses already had another text. {nombre}'s version was kept too: open those verses in the editor to choose which stays.
glosario.ayuda: How the team translates the words of the original. They are added from the editor: touch a word and «Add to the glossary».
glosario.buscarAyuda: A word in your language or of the original
glosario.vacio: No words in the glossary yet.
glosario.compartirAyuda: To pass it to another computer without internet: as a file (memory stick, message) or by copying its text into a message.
glosario.recibirAyuda: Another translator's: it joins this one, nothing lost. If someone translated a word another way, it stays as another form for the team to decide.
glosario.pegarAyuda: Paste the text of a glossary here
glosario.door43Ayuda: Soon: publish it to Door43, in the {repo} repository, in Taller's format, for other teams to look up and bring.
glosario.nadaRecibido: No glossary words were found in what was received.
glosario.juntado: Joined. New: {nuevas} · already the same: {iguales} · with another form to decide: {otras}.
glosario.copiado: The glossary's text was copied. Paste it into a message.
glosario.noCopiado: It could not be copied. Save it as a file.
